title: [SV+] Harvester VM Scorecard
description: One row per running VM: contention, storage health, backups and right-sizing in a single sortable table. 'Flags' counts the warning thresholds a VM is over. Blank means no data or none (for example no qemu-guest-agent).

panels.title: Running VMs
panels.description: VMs with a running instance in the selection.

panels.title: VMs flagged
panels.description: Running VMs over at least one warning threshold.

panels.title: Unhealthy volumes
panels.description: Longhorn volumes that are degraded or faulted (detached volumes report 'unknown' and are not counted).

panels.title: VM volumes never backed up
panels.description: Volumes of VM disks with no Longhorn backup ever recorded.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (namespace, name) (label_replace(label_replace((longhorn_volume_last_backup_at == bool 0), "namespace", "$1", "pvc_namespace", "(.*)"), "persistentvolumeclaim", "$1", "pvc", "(.*)") * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left (name) (max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, name) (kubevirt_vm_disk_allocated_size_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",name=~"$vm"}) * 0 + 1))) or vector(0)

panels.title: VM scorecard (click a column header to sort; the VM name opens its detail dashboard)
VM scorecard
panels.description: Flags = number of these over their warning level: CPU Ready > 5%, guest memory > 90%, launcher memory > 90% of limit, Longhorn write latency > 20 ms, network drops > 10/s, unhealthy volumes. The saving columns come from the right-sizing dashboard (look-back window and target utilisation variables).
